cues.setup: Dead hang, arms straight, grip just outside shoulders.
cues.exec: Pull the shoulder blades down without bending the elbows.
cues.fix: Elbows bending? Think shrug in reverse, arms stay locked.

cues.setup: Jump or step to the top of the pull-up, chin over the bar.
cues.exec: Lower yourself in 3-5 seconds, all the way to straight arms.
cues.fix: Dropping the last third? Fight it hardest near the bottom.

cues.setup: Loop a band over the bar, knee or foot in the loop.
cues.exec: Pull chin over the bar, lower with control to a dead hang.
cues.fix: Band doing the top half? Use a thinner band, keep reps strict.

cues.setup: Vest or dip belt on, dead hang, shoulders packed.
cues.exec: Pull chin clearly over the bar, lower to full hang each rep.
cues.fix: Half reps creeping in? Drop load, keep the dead-hang start.

cues.setup: Supinated grip shoulder-width, load on belt or vest.
cues.exec: Pull chin over the bar, elbows drive down and back.
cues.fix: Shoulders rolling forward? Lead with the chest, not the chin.

cues.setup: Wide grip, pull to one hand, other arm nearly straight.
cues.exec: Lower slowly over the working arm, straight arm guides only.
cues.fix: Straight arm pulling? Point its thumb up, load the near side.

cues.setup: Wide grip, pull chin over the bar and stay there.
cues.exec: Slide chest from hand to hand, keep chin above bar height.
cues.fix: Dipping mid-slide? Shorten the travel, own each side first.

cues.setup: Dead hang, slightly narrower than normal pull-up grip.
cues.exec: Pull explosively until the chest touches the bar.
cues.fix: Kipping for height? Reset to a strict dead-hang start.

cues.setup: Dead hang, body tight, no swing.
cues.exec: Pull hard enough that the hands leave or unload the bar.
cues.fix: Using the hips? Freeze the legs, power comes from the lats.

cues.setup: Chest-to-bar height, false grip helps on the bar.
cues.exec: Roll wrists over the bar, elbows travel from below to above.
cues.fix: Stuck at the lip? Lower through the transition slowly instead.

cues.setup: Chin over the bar on one arm, other hand free or on the wrist.
cues.exec: Lower on one arm in 5+ seconds, all the way to straight.
cues.fix: Shoulder unpacking at the bottom? End the rep before it does.

edges.note: zweite Hand stützt am breiten Griff

cues.setup: Wide supinated-to-neutral grip, body tight.
cues.exec: Pull to one hand, far arm stays long and guides.
cues.fix: Hips twisting? Square them to the bar the whole rep.

cues.setup: Top of a pull-up, knees tucked, elbows locked to the ribs.
cues.exec: Swing back into a tuck lever with straight arms, pull back up.
cues.fix: Arms bending in the lever? Smaller tuck, slower swing.

edges.note: Hebel-Zug aus dem Hang statt vom Klimmzug

cues.setup: Dead hang, arms locked, body hollow.
cues.exec: Raise the body to horizontal with straight arms, lower slow.
cues.fix: Hips breaking? Raise only as far as the line stays straight.

cues.setup: Advanced tuck lever, hips level with shoulders.
cues.exec: Extend one leg fully, keep hips square and body horizontal.
cues.fix: Hips sagging? Re-tuck, extend the leg only halfway.

cues.setup: Hang from rings, knees tucked to the chest.
cues.exec: Rotate back through the hang until feet point down, return.
cues.fix: Rushing the deep position? Pause in the German hang each rep.

cues.setup: Rotate through the hang until the feet point at the floor.
cues.exec: Hang with straight arms, shoulders in deep extension.
cues.fix: Sharp shoulder pain? Tuck tighter, reduce the rotation depth.

cues.setup: Band anchored high, arms straight, slight forward lean.
cues.exec: Pull the band to the hips with locked elbows, lats only.
cues.fix: Elbows bending? Lighter band, think pushing the floor away.

cues.setup: Dead hang on rings, wrists neutral, shoulders packed.
cues.exec: Pull up while the rings rotate naturally, chin past hands.
cues.fix: Rings wobbling hard? Slow the rep, squeeze them inward.

cues.setup: Vest or belt on, full grip on the bar, arms straight.
cues.exec: Hang with packed shoulders, breathe, grip never opens.
cues.fix: Shoulders at the ears? Pull the blades down, stay active.

cues.setup: Support on a single bar, bar at the hips, lean forward.
cues.exec: Dip until shoulders near the bar, press back to lockout.
cues.fix: Bar drifting from the body? Keep it grazing the torso.

cues.setup: Bar behind the hips, hands behind you, legs straight ahead.
cues.exec: Lower until shoulders stretch deeply, press back up.
cues.fix: Shoulders screaming? Reduce depth, build the stretch slowly.

cues.setup: Knees down, hands under shoulders, body straight knee to head.
cues.exec: Chest to the floor, press back up without piking.
cues.fix: Hips hinging? Squeeze glutes and keep the line.

cues.setup: Hands on parallettes, shoulders stacked over wrists.
cues.exec: Lower the chest below hand level, press to full lockout.
cues.fix: Shoulders rolling forward at depth? Stop 2 cm higher.

cues.setup: Feet on a box, hands under the shoulders on the floor.
cues.exec: Lower until the nose nearly touches, press back up straight.
cues.fix: Hips sagging downhill? Brace like a plank, tuck the pelvis.

cues.setup: Standard push-up position, body one rigid line.
cues.exec: 3 seconds down, 1 second pause on the chest, drive up.
cues.fix: Pause disappearing? Count it out loud, no bouncing.

cues.setup: Hands 1.5x shoulder width, fingers slightly out.
cues.exec: Chest between the hands, elbows about 45 degrees out.
cues.fix: Elbows flaring to 90? Bring them in, save the shoulders.

cues.setup: Wide stance hands, shift weight over one arm.
cues.exec: Lower slowly over the loaded arm, far arm stays straight.
cues.fix: Straight arm pushing? Slide it further out, fingertips only.

cues.setup: One hand on the floor, the other on a ball or low block.
cues.exec: Push mostly through the floor hand, elevated arm assists.
cues.fix: Weight drifting to the block? Lift its fingers off briefly.

cues.setup: Feet wide, one hand centered, other behind the back.
cues.exec: Lower in 3-5 seconds without twisting, reset at the bottom.
cues.fix: Shoulder rotating open? Screw the hand into the floor.

cues.setup: Feet on a box, hips stacked high over the shoulders.
cues.exec: Lower the head to the floor between the hands, press up.
cues.fix: Turning into a push-up? Keep the hips over the hands.

cues.setup: Kick up against the wall, hands shoulder width.
cues.exec: Lower until the head kisses the floor, press to lockout.
cues.fix: Banana back? Ribs in, heels lead up the wall.

cues.setup: Wall handstand, body tight, gaze between the hands.
cues.exec: Lower to the floor in 3-5 seconds, kick down, reset.
cues.fix: Crashing the last inch? Stop the rep set one rep earlier.

cues.setup: Band from the bar around the hips, hands on the floor.
cues.exec: Lean and float into the planche line, arms locked.
cues.fix: Band carrying you? Thinner band, shorter honest holds.

cues.setup: Straddle or tuck planche on parallettes, arms locked.
cues.exec: Bend the arms and lower the body level, keep the lean.
cues.fix: Feet touching down? Regress to the smaller planche shape.

cues.setup: Jump to support on the rings, arms locked at the sides.
cues.exec: Hold still, turn the rings slightly out, shoulders down.
cues.fix: Rings drifting apart? Squeeze them toward the hips.

cues.setup: Band across the rings under knees or feet, start in support.
cues.exec: Dip until shoulders pass the elbows, press and turn out.
cues.fix: Losing the rings at depth? Keep elbows tracking backward.

cues.setup: Rings just above the floor, plank position on the straps.
cues.exec: Lower the chest between the rings, press and turn out.
cues.fix: Shaking wildly? Raise the rings, shorten the lever.

cues.setup: Hands on the bench edge behind you, legs out front.
cues.exec: Bend the elbows to 90, press back up, chest tall.
cues.fix: Shoulders shrugging up? Keep the neck long, depth modest.

cues.setup: Jump to support on dip bars, arms fully locked.
cues.exec: Hold still, shoulders pressed down away from the ears.
cues.fix: Sinking into the shoulders? Push the bars away hard.

cues.setup: Support on parallettes, shoulders down, arms locked.
cues.exec: Lift the knees to the chest, hold with feet off the floor.
cues.fix: Shoulders creeping up? Push the ground away, stay tall.

cues.setup: Sit in a pike, hands on the floor beside the knees.
cues.exec: Lift both heels off the floor with straight legs, hold briefly.
cues.fix: Knees bending? Lift lower but keep the legs locked.

cues.setup: Hollow hold: lower back pressed down, arms overhead.
cues.exec: Rock from shoulders to hips without breaking the shape.
cues.fix: Lower back popping off? Shrink the shape, arms forward.

cues.setup: Lie on a bench, grip behind the head, body up on shoulders.
cues.exec: Lower the straight body slowly, only shoulders touching.
cues.fix: Hips folding? Tuck one knee until the line holds.

cues.setup: Dead hang, shoulders slightly active, legs together.
cues.exec: Curl the knees above hip height, lower without swinging.
cues.fix: Swinging between reps? Pause each rep at the bottom.

cues.setup: Kick or kip the toes to the bar once, then take over.
cues.exec: Lower the straight legs as slowly as possible, no swing.
cues.fix: Legs bending on the way down? Bend both knees equally.

cues.setup: Flag grip on the pole, pull down with the top arm.
cues.exec: Hold the body sideways with knees tucked to the chest.
cues.fix: Hips rotating skyward? Stack them, chest faces forward.

cues.setup: Elbow under the shoulder, feet stacked, body straight.
cues.exec: Lift the hips into one line, hold and breathe.
cues.fix: Hips dropping? Shorten the set, keep the line honest.

cues.setup: On your back, legs vertical, arms wide for support.
cues.exec: Lower the legs side to side, shoulders stay on the floor.
cues.fix: Shoulders lifting? Smaller arc, slower tempo.

cues.setup: Kneel, wheel under the shoulders, hips slightly tucked.
cues.exec: Roll out as far as the flat back allows, pull back with abs.
cues.fix: Lower back arching? Shorten the rollout range.

cues.setup: Hold a post, doorframe or chair back at arm's length.
cues.exec: Sit back and down as deep as comfortable, pull lightly up.
cues.fix: Pulling with the arms? Use fingertips only, legs do the work.

edges.note: statisch an der Wand statt dynamisch

cues.setup: Stand on one leg in front of a box, other leg forward.
cues.exec: Sit back to a light touch on the box, stand without rocking.
cues.fix: Plopping down? Higher box, slower descent.

cues.setup: Hold a post or strap, stand on one leg, other leg forward.
cues.exec: Full-depth single-leg squat with the lightest possible pull.
cues.fix: Heel lifting? Elevate it slightly, keep working the ankle.

cues.setup: Grab the rear ankle behind you, stand tall on one leg.
cues.exec: Lower until the rear knee kisses the floor, stand up any way.
cues.fix: Knee slamming down? Slow the last third, pad the floor.

cues.setup: Kneel with the ankles anchored, hips fully open.
cues.exec: Fall forward as slowly as possible, catch with the hands.
cues.fix: Breaking at the hips? Squeeze glutes, body one line.

edges.note: Band nimmt Last aus der Exzentrik

cues.setup: Band from a high anchor to the chest, ankles fixed.
cues.exec: Lower and curl back up, band helps most at the bottom.
cues.fix: Band too strong? You should barely make the last rep.

cues.setup: Wide stance, toes slightly out, arms forward as balance.
cues.exec: Sit fully over one leg, other leg straight, then switch.
cues.fix: Heel lifting? Stay higher until the ankle allows depth.

cues.setup: Hold a post or strap, take a wide stance.
cues.exec: Shift side to side into the deep cossack, pull as needed.
cues.fix: Collapsing inward? Track the knee over the toes.

cues.setup: Hold a pole or doorframe, heels raised, body tall.
cues.exec: Drive knees forward and lean back, hips stay extended.
cues.fix: Folding at the hips? Smaller range, hips locked open.

cues.setup: Stand tall, knees nearly straight, weight on the balls.
cues.exec: Bounce off the ankles, short ground contact, arms drive.
cues.fix: Knees bending deep? It's an ankle jump, not a squat jump.

cues.setup: Balls of the feet on a step, heels hanging free.
cues.exec: Full stretch at the bottom, high pause at the top.
cues.fix: Bouncing out of the stretch? 2-second pause down there.

cues.setup: On your back, feet close to the hips, arms at the sides.
cues.exec: Drive the hips up, squeeze the glutes hard at the top.
cues.fix: Lower back doing the lift? Tuck the pelvis before pushing.

cues.setup: Plank with the feet at the wall base, hands forward.
cues.exec: Walk feet up and hands back until the chest meets the wall.
cues.fix: Back arching hard? Stop earlier, keep ribs tucked.

cues.setup: Walk up the wall until only the toes touch, chest to wall.
cues.exec: Stack wrists-shoulders-hips, push tall, breathe.
cues.fix: Banana shape? Pull the toes off, find the hollow line.

cues.setup: Chest-to-wall handstand, feet lightly on the wall.
cues.exec: Shift the weight fully to one arm, tap the free shoulder.
cues.fix: Hips swinging? Shift slower, push the floor away first.

cues.setup: Chest-to-wall handstand, body in one tight line.
cues.exec: Pull both heels off the wall, balance on the fingertips.
cues.fix: Falling toward the wall? Grip harder, lean a hair more.

cues.setup: Solid wall handstand, fingers spread wide.
cues.exec: Shift weight over one arm, unload the other to fingertips.
cues.fix: Hip sagging toward the free arm? Push taller, shift less.

cues.setup: Feet on a box in a deep pike, shoulders over the hands.
cues.exec: Lean forward and float the feet up toward handstand.
cues.fix: Jumping instead of pressing? Lean further, move slower.

cues.setup: Back to the wall one step away, arms overhead.
cues.exec: Arch back and walk the hands down the wall, walk back up.
cues.fix: Pinching the low back? Step further out, open the chest.

cues.setup: Sit in a wide straddle, spine long, hips rolled forward.
cues.exec: Walk the hands forward, chest leads toward the floor.
cues.fix: Back rounding immediately? Sit on a cushion, narrow the straddle.

cues.setup: Sit with legs together and straight, toes pulled back.
cues.exec: Hinge at the hips and reach along the legs, spine long.
cues.fix: Knees bending? Less depth, keep the quads squeezed.

cues.setup: Kneeling lunge, front leg straightens, hips square.
cues.exec: Sit back over the rear knee, fold over the front leg.
cues.fix: Hips twisting open? Square them before adding depth.

cues.setup: Rear shin up the wall, front foot flat, torso tall.
cues.exec: Tuck the pelvis and squeeze the rear glute, hold.
cues.fix: Low back arching? More pelvic tuck, less upright torso.

cues.setup: Stand tall on a small elevation, chin to the chest.
cues.exec: Roll down one vertebra at a time, hang, roll back up.
cues.fix: Dropping in one piece? Slow down, feel each segment.
